title: Poker Face visual direction
brief: Three distinct visual worlds for the Poker Face party game (Electron, one shared screen, readable across a room). Each artboard stacks six 1280x800 frames: Lobby, Calibration (Get in frame), Calibration (countdown), Live round mid-crack, Live round paused (Back in frame), Session leaderboard. The user picks one direction; none is final.

artboards.title: Fight Night
artboards.tradeoff: Loudest and most legible party energy (title-fight broadcast chrome); also the most familiar vocabulary and framed as competition rather than comedy

artboards.title: Page 100
artboards.tradeoff: Highest contrast and funniest voice (teletext grid, four colour keys, a mosaic face whose mouth bends on a crack); hardest to extend, least premium

artboards.title: Deadpan
artboards.tradeoff: Most distinctive and best in a lit room (quiet gallery, serif, one vermilion crack); least arcade energy, relies on the players for noise
